title: Jeremiah's Prayer and God's Promise of Restoration
description: After Jeremiah bought a field from his relative, he prayed to the Lord and praised His power. He recalled the exodus from Egypt and the people's disobedience, asking how buying the land could make sense when the city was in the hands of the Chaldeans. The Lord answered that He would give the city into Nebuchadnezzar's hand because of the people's idolatry, but promised to gather them back, give them one heart, and establish an everlasting covenant with them, so that fields would again be bought in the land.
